# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 1999

**Appropriation Ordinance No. 01**

## Summary

An appropriation ordinance enacting the Closing Special Budget of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] for the fiscal year ending December 31, 1998. The Municipal Budget Officer, Mrs. Gloria G. Mataragnon, presented the Closing Special Budget to the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] for review. After verification and deliberation, the body found the budget to be in conformity with existing budgetary and accounting rules and regulations of the Department of Budget and Management and Commission on Audit. The ordinance was passed on motion by Councilor [[Emilio R. Veloso]] and seconded by Councilor [[Vidal L. Glinoga Jr.]]

**Total savings from all municipal offices:** P 732,658.50
**Total amount reverted to the general fund:** P 1,450,803.48 (from savings of P 732,658.50, plus P 537,159.15 reverted, plus P 502,546.08 treated as continuing appropriations)

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** The amount of P 732,658.50 is hereby appropriated from savings in all municipal offices amounting to P 1,450,803.48; the amount of P 537,159.15 is hereby reverted to the general fund; and the amount of P 502,546.08 is hereby treated as continuing appropriations to cover overdraft in appropriations and adjust all existing balances of appropriations respectively.
- **Section 2.** The Closing Special Budget prepared and submitted by the Municipal Budget Officer is hereby attached and marked as Annex "A" and made an integral part of this ordinance.
- **Section 3.** Enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] on January 4, 1999 at Pitogo, Quezon.

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] — enacted the ordinance
- [[Gloria G. Mataragnon]] — Municipal Budget Officer (presented the Closing Special Budget)
- [[Emilio R. Veloso]] — Councilor (moved for approval)
- [[Vidal L. Glinoga Jr.]] — Councilor (seconded the motion)
- [[Rodante V. Cortes]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer
- [[Dante L. Punac Sr.]] — Municipal Mayor (approved)
- [[Sogracia S. Borisel]] — Secretary to the Sangguniang Bayan

## Legal Basis (RA 7160 Sections)

- [[RA-7160|Republic Act No. 7160]] (Local Government Code of 1991)
  - [[Sec-16-RA7160|Section 16]] — General welfare clause
  - [[Sec-447-RA7160|Section 447]] — Powers of the Sangguniang Bayan

## Timeline

- Enacted: January 4, [[1999]]
- Covers fiscal year ending December 31, [[1998]]
